function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('a[href^="/ja/article/"]').each((i,e)=>{const a=$(e);let href=a.attr('href');if(!href)return;if(!/\/ja\/article\/.+/.test(href))return;posts.push({url:href,title:a.text().trim(),publishedAt:a.closest('article,.post').find('time').first().attr('datetime')||null});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const title=$('article h1,main h1').first().text().trim();const author=$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('[rel="author"]').first().text().trim()||null;const publishedAt=$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null;const body=$('.prose').first().clone();body.find('script,style,noscript,nav,footer,.header-anchor,.upvote-form,.post-footer,.toc,.table-of-contents').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author,publishedAt,tags:$('[rel="tag"]').map((i,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
scraper.notes: Live listing a[href^="/ja/article/"]; article body .prose; title article h1,main h1.
